points.quote: **`framework/`** holds the four core packages ... **`affine/`** is the Affine editor built on that framework.
`store`: the Yjs-backed document model (docs, blocks, schemas, transactions).
`std`: the runtime that renders and drives the editor. It covers block views, selection, commands, services and the canvas/gfx runtime.
`blocks`: block types ... `widgets`: floating UI such as toolbar, slash-menu, drag-handle ... `fragments`: side panels such as outline, frame-panel, doc-title and adapter-panel.
Each feature package typically provides a model, a view and store extensions. Behaviour is composed through an extension system rather than hard-coded.
Nothing inside `blocksuite/` imports from the rest of the repo, but the rest of the repo imports it about 1,170 times.
